description: Canonical keys for a completed self-build slice handoff (Cursor or human). requiredReportFields align with reddirt_selfbuild_slice_schema.json for JSON automation. standardReturnFormat and architectureReturnFormat are standard Markdown heading orders for final responses.

sections.description: Product lane root (e.g. RedDirt/). Must match slice contract.
Echo the slice packet id executed.
Each item: { command, cwd, exitCode, summary } where summary is redacted and non-secret.
Each item: { kind, reference, notes } — kind examples: cli_log_path, doc_anchor, screenshot_policy, operator_attestation; no secret payloads.
Fields such as: stayedWithinAllowedPaths (boolean), noForbiddenActions (boolean), approvalsSought (array of strings), exceptionsNoneOrListed (string).
Which progressEffects from the slice occurred (or explicit none with reason).
Honest open risks; empty array means none known.
Single default follow-on packet id or no-op justification.

optionalSections.description: Set when slice touched public form → DB intake; omit or false otherwise.
Doc or route reference for operator review/export when applicable.
Short statement whether compressing later-day work remains safe given proofs.
